rules.safeZone: Key food inside the centre 400 x 640 px (x 400-800, y 80-720). Whole plate or bowl inside y 80-720.

photos.title: Pork Sinigang
mustShow: Light, slightly cloudy sour broth (not thick, not red)
Chunks of pork (ribs or belly) with some fat
Quartered tomatoes and onion in the soup
mayShow: Small bowl of rice at the edge
photos.telltale: Clear-ish broth with tomato wedges and pork. Must look different from Tinola (no ginger strips, has tomato).

photos.title: Tinolang Manok
mayShow: Green leaves (spinach, chili leaves or malunggay)
Small bowl of rice at the edge
photos.telltale: Clear chicken soup with ginger and green leaves. No tomato, so it reads differently from Sinigang.

photos.title: Arroz Caldo
mustShow: Thick, creamy rice porridge (not a clear soup)
mayShow: Half a hard-boiled egg (small, not the main focus)
Calamansi or lemon on the side
photos.telltale: Porridge texture is the key. It must not look like Tinola.

photos.title: Bistek Tagalog
mustShow: Thin slices of beef in dark soy sauce
Soft onion rings on top, clearly visible
mayShow: A little rice at the edge
mustNotShow: Raw onion slices with no cooking
photos.telltale: Onion rings on dark-glazed thin beef. Must look different from Chicken Adobo.

photos.title: Chicken Afritada
mayShow: Red or green bell pepper squares
A little rice at the edge
mustNotShow: Green peas as a main feature
photos.telltale: Tomato-red stew. Must look different from Japanese Curry (brown) and Adobo (dark).

photos.title: Pancit Canton
mayShow: A few slices of chicken, pork or shrimp
photos.telltale: Glossy yellow noodles. Must look different from Yakisoba (brown sauce, Japanese style).

photos.title: Paksiw na Isda
mustShow: Whole fish (bangus, tilapia or mackerel) in a thin light sauce
photos.telltale: Whole fish simmered in a light vinegar sauce. Must look different from Shioyaki (grilled).

photos.title: Tamagoyaki
photos.vessel: Small rectangular plate or wooden board
mustShow: Visible layered spiral on the cut side
mayShow: A small dish of soy sauce
photos.telltale: Layers visible on the cut face.

photos.title: Home-Style Yakisoba
mustShow: Wheat noodles in a brown savoury sauce
mayShow: A little aonori or pickled ginger
photos.telltale: Brown sauce noodles with cabbage. Different from Pancit Canton.

photos.title: Home-Style Nikujaga
mayShow: A few green beans or snow peas
photos.telltale: Light broth stew. Different from Japanese Curry and Afritada.

photos.title: Shogayaki (Ginger Pork)
mustShow: Thin pork slices in a glossy ginger-soy glaze
mayShow: Finely shredded raw cabbage beside the pork
photos.telltale: Glazed thin pork with shredded cabbage. Different from Gyudon (beef on rice).

photos.title: Teriyaki Chicken
mustShow: Pan-fried chicken thigh with skin, sliced
mustNotShow: Vegetable stir-fry as the main feature
photos.telltale: Sliced glazed chicken thigh with crisp skin.

photos.title: Butter Soy Mushrooms
mustShow: Browned mushrooms (shiitake, shimeji or button) glossy with butter and soy
photos.telltale: A side dish of mushrooms only.

photos.title: Salt-Grilled Fish (Shioyaki)
mustShow: Salmon or mackerel with crisp, lightly charred skin
photos.telltale: Grilled fish, no sauce. Different from Paksiw (simmered in sauce).

photos.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
photos.telltale: Shrimp in butter, no pasta. Different from Garlic Butter Pasta.

photos.title: French Toast
mustShow: Two or three slices of golden pan-fried bread with an egg coating
mayShow: A little syrup or powdered sugar
photos.telltale: Golden egg-soaked bread slices.

photos.title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
mustShow: Melted cheese visible at the cut
photos.telltale: Cheese pull or melt at the cut edge.

photos.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
photos.vessel: Wide white plate or pasta bowl
photos.telltale: Pale buttery spaghetti. Different from Garlic Butter Shrimp.

photos.title: Chicken and Bell Pepper Stir-Fry
mustShow: Colourful bell pepper strips (red, green or yellow)
Onion slices in a light soy glaze
photos.telltale: Bright pepper strips with chicken.

photos.title: Spinach and Cheese Omelette
mustShow: Wilted spinach and melted cheese visible at the fold
photos.telltale: Folded omelette with green and cheese at the fold. Different from Tamagoyaki and Spanish Omelette.
